messages:
toni: quick drop — I'm proposing a compact intake flow to catch interface/quant problems before full bench. sketch below.
gabby: love a compact path, paste it.
toni: ```
preflight:
  - descriptor_lint (owner, ops_list, quant_profile)
  - tokenizer_hash check
  - mini_bench: 8 golden samples (short/mid/long)
  - synthetic_kv_smoke in sandbox
pre-acceptance:
  - micro_eval: 20 gold prompts (LL/EM probe, opt-in large models)
  - quant_fingerprint verify on subset
rollout:
  - staged: 0.1% -> 0.5% -> 1% with auto-gates
```
mike: synthetic_kv_smoke avoids prod flakiness, +1. we still need an optional live cache check in acceptance.
infra-bot: note: descriptor_lint failed for lavender-v2: missing onboard-owner field.
gabby: mapping signals -> actions? i propose: BLOCK for tokenizer mismatch, missing ops, checksum fail; WARN for median perf drift >5% or mem +10%; INFO for tail jitter.
toni: agree. owners auto-notified on BLOCK, admit-bot posts structured event.
ops: add manifest field quant_profile.fingerprint and boolean reproduce_on_subset to make quant checks deterministic.
mike: action items: gabby will draft numeric thresholds (EOW), infra to add synthetic_kv_smoke hook (next sprint), toni will update admit-bot message schema.
gabby: i'll start the thresholds doc. thanks.
